test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**record**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "warmest year on ____" requires a word that refers to documented history or collected data.
 
• **Record** (Option 1) is the most appropriate word. The idiom "on record" means "according to available information or data.&quo
